launcher.newSessionDescription: Create a new Hermes RPC session
launcher.resumeLatestDescription: Resume the stored session when available

auto_start_bridge.description: Start the local Python bridge when it is unavailable.
auto_start_bridge.label: Auto-start bridge

auto_start_gateway.description: Start the Hermes gateway when the bridge reports it stopped.
auto_start_gateway.label: Auto-start gateway

bridge_host.description: Host exposed by the local bridge or SSH port forward.
bridge_host.label: Bridge host

bridge_token.description: Token printed by the remote hermes-bridge-serve helper.
bridge_token.label: Bridge token

client_only_mode.description: Connect to an existing remote bridge instead of starting a local process.
client_only_mode.label: Client-only mode

hide_when_idle.description: Hide the bar widget while Hermes is online and idle.
hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle

poll_interval.description: Seconds between idle bridge polls. Active sessions poll every two seconds.
poll_interval.label: Status poll interval

show_tool_activity.description: Keep tool-call activity visible when the session is not busy.
show_tool_activity.label: Show tool activity

state_file.description: State JSON written by the local Hermes bridge.
state_file.label: State file
